title: suction cup soap cups
text: suction cup soap cups. These look nice... but only one stays put.  They are really really hard to get them to position and stay.  They also have a super strong plastic/?? odor.  You put the base together which is an aluminum tube (very sharp at the ends so be careful) into the dish base and the suction cup.  Then work HARD to get them to stay down.  I found a little moisture, place the base and hold it down for a few minutes (YES - MINUTES).  Honestly, they are nice, but too hard to use. I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful. Further, I never accept free products - my reviews are 100% honest and reflect my own personal experience.
